messages.label: for each session with liveness evidence
Session Catalog — sessions, unreadable sources, discovered count

cards.title: Asked independently
items: An environment with only one agent installed is the ordinary case
One unreadable source must not cost the reader the other's sessions
Each source contributes its sessions or its name to unreadable

cards.title: Collapsed, then assessed
items: One session can leave a live marker per process and a transcript
The most recent evidence wins, because that is the process actually running
Liveness is assessed last, per session, against one clock

cards.title: How complete the answer is
items: The reading may stop at the most recent sessions per agent
How many exist travels back with what was described
Unreadable sources are named in the catalog, not silently dropped
